name: FloatingCombatText
src_typeComment: One spawned instance's animation: pop-in scale, drift per its CombatTextMotion, fade-out over the last 30% of its lifetime, then hands itself back to FloatingCombatTextSpawner's pool. Kept as a separate component from the spawner (rather than one big class) so a custom prefab can be built/tested on its own, the same split FlyToUIEffect uses between the spawner and its pooled icon instances.

src_members.sig: public void Play(string text, CombatTextPreset config, Action<FloatingCombatText> onFinished)
